_note: Floors for scripts/shot_tag_score.py. right + makes_missed + misses_called_makes
must equal tags, because every tag lands in exactly one bucket.
adrian_111 is the best score anyone has recorded on the coach's 111 shot tags
(38 makes, 73 misses), carried over from docs/agent_handoffs/HERMES.md and
ACTIVE.md. It was measured offline on the v6 tracks, which are not in git, so
nobody has reproduced it from this repo alone. The first person to run
scripts/shot_tag_score.py on the home laptop should say in the pull request
whether the database reproduces it, and correct this number if it does not.
Do not lower a floor to make a change pass. Raise it when a change beats it,
in the same pull request, and say what moved.
